```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# BAYESIAN-NETWORK-INSPIRED DEPENDENCY GRAPH SCORE
# standalone version on supermarket train

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

# BASKET FEATURES

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments
  )

# CO-OCCURRENCE SCORE

basket_depts <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    depts = list(sort(unique(department))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

edge_counts <- purrr::map_dfr(basket_depts$depts, function(depts) {
  if (length(depts) < 2) {
    return(tibble(dept_a = integer(), dept_b = integer()))
  }
  pairs <- t(combn(depts, 2))
  tibble(
    dept_a = pairs[, 1],
    dept_b = pairs[, 2]
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::count(dept_a, dept_b, name = "edge_n")

edge_lookup <- edge_counts %>%
  mutate(
    edge_key = paste(dept_a, dept_b, sep = "_"),
    edge_commonness = edge_n / max(edge_n),
    edge_surprise = 1 - edge_commonness
  )

edge_surprise_lookup <- edge_lookup$edge_surprise
names(edge_surprise_lookup) <- edge_lookup$edge_key

get_edge_keys <- function(depts) {
  depts <- sort(unique(depts))
  if (length(depts) < 2) return(character(0))
  pairs <- t(combn(depts, 2))
  paste(pairs[, 1], pairs[, 2], sep = "_")
}

cooccurrence_score_tbl <- basket_depts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    edge_keys = list(get_edge_keys(depts)),
    cooccurrence_score = ifelse(
      length(edge_keys) > 0,
      mean(edge_surprise_lookup[edge_keys], na.rm = TRUE),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(transaction_id, cooccurrence_score)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(cooccurrence_score_tbl, by = "transaction_id")

# DEPARTMENT RISK FROM STOCKTAKE

stocktake <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/stocktake_missing.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    item_value = as.numeric(item_value)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(department), !is.na(item_value), item_value >= 0)

stocktake_profile <- stocktake %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    missing_count = n(),
    missing_mean_value = mean(item_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dept_risk = 0.5 * percent_rank(missing_count) +
                0.5 * percent_rank(missing_mean_value)
  )

long_risk <- long_data %>%
  left_join(
    stocktake_profile %>% select(department, dept_risk),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dept_risk = replace_na(dept_risk, median(stocktake_profile$dept_risk, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

risk_tbl <- long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_department_risk = mean(dept_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_department_risk = sum(price * dept_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(risk_tbl, by = "transaction_id")

# EXPECTED DEPENDENCIES

m_price_items <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)
m_time_items <- lm(total_time ~ total_items, data = basket_data)
m_maxshare_maxprice <- lm(max_price_share ~ max_price, data = basket_data)
m_cooccur_depts <- lm(cooccurrence_score ~ unique_departments, data = basket_data)
m_valueconc_risk <- lm(max_price_share ~ avg_department_risk, data = basket_data)

mad_safe <- function(x) {
  v <- mad(x, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(v) || v <= 0) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) else v
}

basket_bn <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    pred_total_price = predict(m_price_items, newdata = .),
    pred_total_time = predict(m_time_items, newdata = .),
    pred_max_price_share = predict(m_maxshare_maxprice, newdata = .),
    pred_cooccurrence_score = predict(m_cooccur_depts, newdata = .),
    pred_value_concentration = predict(m_valueconc_risk, newdata = .)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    resid_price_items = total_price - pred_total_price,
    resid_time_items = total_time - pred_total_time,
    resid_maxshare_maxprice = max_price_share - pred_max_price_share,
    resid_cooccur_depts = cooccurrence_score - pred_cooccurrence_score,
    resid_valueconc_risk = max_price_share - pred_value_concentration
  )

scale_price_items <- mad_safe(basket_bn$resid_price_items)
scale_time_items <- mad_safe(basket_bn$resid_time_items)
scale_maxshare_maxprice <- mad_safe(basket_bn$resid_maxshare_maxprice)
scale_cooccur_depts <- mad_safe(basket_bn$resid_cooccur_depts)
scale_valueconc_risk <- mad_safe(basket_bn$resid_valueconc_risk)

basket_bn <- basket_bn %>%
  mutate(
    z_price_items = abs(resid_price_items) / scale_price_items,
    z_time_items = abs(resid_time_items) / scale_time_items,
    z_maxshare_maxprice = abs(resid_maxshare_maxprice) / scale_maxshare_maxprice,
    z_cooccur_depts = abs(resid_cooccur_depts) / scale_cooccur_depts,
    z_valueconc_risk = abs(resid_valueconc_risk) / scale_valueconc_risk,
    dependency_graph_score =
      z_price_items +
      z_time_items +
      z_maxshare_maxprice +
      z_cooccur_depts +
      z_valueconc_risk
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(dependency_graph_score))

top_150_dependency_graph_train <- basket_bn %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_dependency_graph_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_dependency_graph_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_dependency_graph_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_dependency_graph_train$cooccurrence_score)
summary(top_150_dependency_graph_train$avg_department_risk)
summary(top_150_dependency_graph_train$dependency_graph_score)

write.csv(
  top_150_dependency_graph_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_dependency_graph_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
